body: My note says the farm crew washed their sample jars in this sink. The water turned milky; two hours later a patrol told us not to use the tap.
title: Recipe page, lower corner
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

body:
They told us to throw away the board but to leave the knife. I said we had served from both, and the man at the door asked only who had signed the delivery.

My helper had signed because I was late. She stayed behind to clean when they took the board. They asked for her address, then said she could go home.

We still have the order book. A page is gone, though the food from that order was already on the table.
title: The missing cutting board
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
